result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign and Adobe Acrobat Sign** are the three strongest options. However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, whether you need automated contracts, and how much you want to spend.

My recommendation is to prioritise four things\:

- **Ease of use\:** Customers should be able to sign without creating an account.
- **Cost\:** Avoid paying enterprise prices for basic electronic signatures.
- **Automation\:** Templates, reminders, signing sequences and reusable documents.
- **Legal validity\:** A clear audit trail, timestamps and identity verification where needed.

Since you're in Australia, I'd also consider compatibility with Australian electronic transaction laws.

## Best e-signature platforms compared

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. DocuSign**

(Best overall)

- Excellent document tracking and audit trails.
- Templates, automated reminders and signing workflows.
- Broad integrations with business software.
- Best for businesses wanting a recognised, established platform.

Published starting prices vary by plan; entry-level pricing is around US\$15/month in some markets.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

**2\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for simplicity)

- Very easy to use.
- Straightforward signing experience for customers.
- Templates and signing reminders.
- Good choice for small businesses that don't need complicated workflows.

Paid plans start around US\$15/month on annual billing.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Useful for contracts and formal business documents.
- Strong integration with Adobe Acrobat.
- Particularly good if your business already uses Adobe.

Plans vary; some start around US\$16.99/month.

[Visit Adobe Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

- Creates proposals, quotes and contracts.
- Electronic signatures built into documents.
- Templates and document automation.
- Excellent for sales-focused businesses.

Paid plans start around US\$19/user/month on annual billing.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Sign**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable for smaller teams.
- Document templates and automated workflows.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.
- Good value if you want to keep software costs down.

Free tier available; paid plans start around US\$10/user/month annually.

[Visit Zoho Sign](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small business\:

| Requirement | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-rounder | DocuSign |
| Easiest to use | Dropbox Sign |
| Best for contracts and PDFs | Adobe Sign |
| Best for proposals and quotes | PandaDoc |
| Best budget option | Zoho Sign |


**One Australian consideration\:** Electronic signatures are generally recognised under the Commonwealth Electronic Transactions Act 1999, subject to requirements and exceptions. State laws and document-specific rules can also apply. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
